```{r, include=FALSE}

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# datetime->date & time

# renaming columns to change
names(calls) [6] <- "response_datetime" 
names(calls) [11] <- "arrived_datetime"
names(calls) [12] <- "closed_datetime"


# breaking columns by index
calls <- calls %>%
  mutate(response_time = str_sub(response_datetime,12,23),
         response_date = str_sub(response_datetime,1,11),
         arrived_time = str_sub(arrived_datetime,12,23),
         arrived_date = str_sub(arrived_datetime,1,11),
         closed_time = str_sub(closed_datetime,12,23),
         closed_date = str_sub(closed_datetime,1,11))

# checking my work
head(calls$response_time)
head(calls$response_date)
head(calls$arrived_time)
head(calls$arrived_date)
head(calls$closed_time)
head(calls$closed_date)

head(calls)
```



```{r, include=TRUE}
as_tibble(calls) %>%
  count(`Call Disposition Description`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = 100)

as_tibble(calls) %>%
  count(`Priority Level`, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = 100)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Call Type Classification
calls_sorted <- calls %>%
  mutate(
    disposition = case_when(
        `Call Disposition Description` %in% c("No Report", "Report Written", "Unable To Locate", "False Alarm", "Supplement     Written", "Non-Police Matter", "Report Written MH", "Reassigned call", "District Representatives", "No Report MH") ~ `Call Disposition Description`,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    priority = `Priority Level`,
    priority_number = as.numeric(str_extract(priority, "\\d+")),
    disposition_clean = str_trim(toupper(disposition)),
    
    calls_disorder = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Disturbance", "Disorderly Conduct", "Property Damage/Vandalism", "Drugs", "Prositution")),
    calls_behavior = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Suspicious Things", "Trespassing")),
    calls_traffic = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Crashes"),
    calls_gun = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` %in% c("Shoot/Stab", "Weapons/Firearms Violations")),
         
        calls_robbery = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Robbery"),
        calls_aggravated_assault = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Aggravated Assault"),
        calls_burglary = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Burglary"),
        calls_theft = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Theft"),
        calls_mv_theft = as.integer(`Initial Problem Category` == "Auto Theft"),
  
            calls_violent = calls_robbery + calls_aggravated_assault,
            calls_property = calls_burglary + calls_theft + calls_mv_theft,
            calls_index = calls_violent + calls_property,
    
              initiator = case_when(
                `Incident Type` == "Officer-Initiated Incident" ~ "Officer",
                `Incident Type` == "Dispatched Incident" ~ "Citizen",
                TRUE ~ NA_character_
              )
              )
```

```{r}
by_day <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    date_response = as_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime))
    ) %>%
      count(date_response, disposition) %>%
      rename(day = date_response)
  
ggplot(by_day, aes(day, n, color = disposition, group = disposition)) +
  geom_line(alpha = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~disposition, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Timeline and Disposition", x = "Day", y = "Calls") 

```



```{r}
by_month <- calls_sorted %>% 
  mutate (
    month_response = floor_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime), "month")
  ) %>%
      count(month_response, disposition) %>%
        rename(month = month_response)

  
ggplot(by_month, aes(month, n, color = disposition, group = disposition)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~disposition, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Month and Disposition", x = "Month", y = "Calls") 
```

```{r}
by_year <- calls_sorted %>% 
  mutate (
    year = floor_date(mdy_hms(response_datetime), "year")
  ) 

by_year_type <- bind_rows(
  by_year %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  by_year %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_violent == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Violent Crime"),
  by_year %>% filter(calls_property == 1) %>% count(year = year, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Property Crime")
)

  
ggplot(by_year_type, aes(year, n, color = disposition, group = disposition)) +
 geom_line(linewidth = .8, alpha = .8) + 
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y", ncol(3)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Year and Disposition", x = "Year", y = "Calls") 


```


```{r, fig_width = 20}
# day of the week distribution and frequency

names(calls_sorted) [9] <- "day_week"

# frequency of calls by day of the week
by_day_week <- calls_sorted %>% count(day = day_week)

  
by_week_type <- bind_rows(
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_robbery == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Robbery"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_aggravated_assault == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Aggravated Assault"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_burglary == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Burglary"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_theft == 1) %>% count(day= day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Theft"), 
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_mv_theft == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "MV Theft"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_disorder == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Disorder"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_behavior == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Susp/Unwanted"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_traffic == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Traffic"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_gun == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Gunshots"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_violent == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Violent Crime"),
  calls_sorted %>% filter(calls_property == 1) %>% count(day = day_week, disposition) %>% mutate(type = "Property Crime")
)

# fix the order of days 
  by_week_type$day <- factor(by_week_type$day, 
                            levels = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"))
  
  ggplot(by_week_type, aes(day, n, color = disposition, group = disposition)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Austin 911 Calls by Day of the Week, Type, and Disposition", x = "Day", y = "Calls") 
  
  

```


```{r, fig.width = 20}

by_time <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(mdy_hms(response_datetime)),
         day_of_week = wday(mdy_hms(response_datetime))
         )

heatmap <- by_time %>%
  group_by(disposition) %>%
  count(day_of_week, hour, disposition) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week,
                              levels = 1:7,
                              labels = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")))
  

heatmap_percent <- heatmap %>%
  mutate( percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100)
  

ggplot(heatmap_percent, aes(hour, day_of_week, fill = percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 4)) +
  facet_wrap(~disposition, scales = "free") + 
  theme_minimal() +
   labs(title = "Austin 911 Call Volume Heatmap by Day, Hour, and Disposition", x = "Hour of Day", y = "Day of Week", fill = "Proportion of Calls") 


```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#Information needed 


df_dates <- expand.grid(year = 2014:2024, month = 1:12, day = 1:31) %>% 

  filter(complete.cases(ymd(paste(year, month, day)))) %>% 

  mutate(date = ymd(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"))) %>% 

  arrange(date) 

 df_dates

#Get suntime data 


df_sun <- df_dates %>% 

  mutate(lat = 30.267118,  

         lon = -97.743130) %>% 

  getSunlightTimes(data = ., tz = "America/Chicago", keep = c("dawn", "sunrise", "sunset", "dusk", "night")) %>% 

  rename_all(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    dawn = hour(dawn) + minute(dawn) / 60,
    sunrise = hour(sunrise) + minute(sunrise) / 60,
    sunset = hour(sunset) + minute(sunset) / 60,
    dusk = hour(dusk) + minute(dusk) / 60,
    night = hour(night) + minute(night) / 60
  )

df_sun

```

```{r}
df_sun %>%
  filter(year(date) == 2023) %>%
  ggplot() +
    geom_area(aes(x = date, y = dusk), fill = "skyblue3") +  
    geom_area(aes(x = date, y = sunset), fill = "khaki1") +  
    geom_area(aes(x = date, y = sunrise), fill = "skyblue3") +  
    geom_area(aes(x = date, y = dawn), fill = "grey90") +  
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +  
      scale_x_date(date_labels =  "%b", date_breaks = "1 month", expand = c(0,0)) + 
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 23)) +  
      labs(x = "Month of 2023", y = "Time of the day") +  
      theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),   
        panel.grid = element_blank(),  
        panel.border = element_blank(),   
        rect = element_blank(),  
        axis.line = element_blank()
        )  

```











```{r}
plottheme <- theme( 
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
  strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12), 
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"), 
  panel.background = element_blank(),  
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
  legend.key = element_rect(colour = "transparent", fill = "transparent"), 
  legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"), 
  legend.text = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.position = "none", 
  rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
  )


dst_dates <- tibble(
  year = 2014:2024,
  dst_spring = as.Date(c("2014-03-09", "2015-03-08", "2016-03-13", "2017-03-12", "2018-03-11", "2019-03-10", "2020-03-08", "2021-03-14", "2022-03-13", "2023-03-12", "2024-03-10")),
  dst_fall = as.Date(c("2014-11-02", "2015-11-01", "2016-11-06", "2017-11-05", "2018-11-04", "2019-11-03", "2020-11-01", "2021-11-07", "2022-11-06", "2023-11-05", "2024-11-03"))
)


calls_night <- calls_sorted %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(substr(response_datetime, 1, 10), format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    time_parsed = strptime(response_time, format = "%I:%M:%S %p"),
    hour_dec = hour(time_parsed) + minute(time_parsed) / 60 + second(time_parsed) / 3600
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_sun, by = "date") %>%
  filter(hour_dec >= sunset & hour_dec < night)

calls_sorted_night <- calls_night %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("calls_"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calls_average_priority = mean(priority_number, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dst_rd_spring <- calls_sorted_night %>%
  mutate( 
    year = year(date)
    ) %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(days_until_spring = as.integer(date - dst_spring)) %>%
  filter(days_until_spring %in% -21:21) %>%
  mutate(
    dst_on = if_else(days_until_spring >= 0, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  group_by(days_until_spring, dst_on) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("calls_"), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calls_average_priority = mean(calls_average_priority, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

vnames <- dst_rd_spring %>% select(starts_with("calls_")) %>% names()


for(X in vnames){ 

  f1 <- as.formula(paste0(X, "~ poly(days_until_spring, 2)")) 
  sub_no  <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "no")
  sub_yes <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "yes")

  if(length(unique(sub_no$days_until_spring)) < 3 | length(unique(sub_yes$days_until_spring)) < 3) next

  lm1 <- lm(f1, data = sub_no)
  lm2 <- lm(f1, data = sub_yes)
  pred1 <- predict(lm1, newdata = sub_no, se = TRUE)
  pred2 <- predict(lm2, newdata = sub_yes, se = TRUE)

  dst_rd_spring_plot <- bind_rows(sub_no, sub_yes) %>%
    mutate(pred = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit), 
           upper = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) - qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit), 
           lower = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) + qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit)) 

  clean_title <- X %>% 
    str_replace("calls_", "") %>% 
    str_replace("_", " ") %>% 
    str_to_title()
  
  ylabel <- ifelse(str_detect(X, "clearedrate"), "Clearance rate", "Crimes") 
  
p <- ggplot(dst_rd_spring_plot, aes(x = days_until_spring, y = .data[[X]])) + 
    geom_point(aes(group = dst_on), size = 3, color = "royalblue", shape = 1) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = pred, group = dst_on)) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = upper, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_line(aes(y = lower, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +  
    labs(title = paste("Austin 911 RD:", clean_title), 
         x = "Days until Spring DST starts", 
         y = ylabel)
print(p)
}

```

  summarise(
    across(starts_with("calls_"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calls_average_priority = mean(priority_number, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dst_rd_fall <- calls_sorted_night %>%
  mutate( 
    year = year(date)
    ) %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(days_until_fall = as.integer(date - dst_fall)) %>%
  filter(days_until_fall %in% -21:21) %>%
  mutate(
    dst_on = if_else(days_until_fall >= 0, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  group_by(days_until_fall, dst_on) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("calls_"), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    calls_average_priority = mean(calls_average_priority, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

vnames <- dst_rd_fall %>% select(starts_with("calls_")) %>% names()


for(X in vnames){ 

  f1 <- as.formula(paste0(X, "~ poly(days_until_fall, 2)")) 
  sub_no  <- dst_rd_fall %>% filter(dst_on == "no")
  sub_yes <- dst_rd_fall %>% filter(dst_on == "yes")

  if(length(unique(sub_no$days_until_fall)) < 3 | length(unique(sub_yes$days_until_fall)) < 3) next

  lm1 <- lm(f1, data = sub_no)
  lm2 <- lm(f1, data = sub_yes)
  pred1 <- predict(lm1, newdata = sub_no, se = TRUE)
  pred2 <- predict(lm2, newdata = sub_yes, se = TRUE)

  dst_rd_fall_plot <- bind_rows(sub_no, sub_yes) %>%
    mutate(pred = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit), 
           upper = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) - qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit), 
           lower = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) + qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit)) 

  clean_title <- X %>% 
    str_replace("calls_", "") %>% 
    str_replace("_", " ") %>% 
    str_to_title()
  
  ylabel <- ifelse(str_detect(X, "clearedrate"), "Clearance rate", "Crimes") 
  
p <- ggplot(dst_rd_fall_plot, aes(x = days_until_fall, y = .data[[X]])) + 
    geom_point(aes(group = dst_on), size = 3, color = "royalblue", shape = 1) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = pred, group = dst_on)) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = upper, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_line(aes(y = lower, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +  
    labs(title = paste("Austin 911 RD:", clean_title), 
         x = "Days until Fall DST starts", 
         y = ylabel)
print(p)
}
